Title: Azure SQL Database Managed Instance—Business-critical service tier now available

Body.Content:
Designed for mission-critical business apps with high I/O requirements, business critical supports high availability with the highest level of storage and compute redundancy. Additionally, you can save up to 80 percent off the license-included full price when you apply Azure Hybrid Benefit for SQL Server and reserved capacity pricing. Learn more about Managed Instance business critical and other Managed Instance updates.

Learn more about the Azure Hybrid Benefit for SQL Server and reserved capacity pricing
